lines.text: 冷蔵庫の野菜室が、冷蔵室より少し温かいって知ってた？
prompts: a bright open refrigerator with a vegetable drawer pulled out, fresh vegetables, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: 実は、野菜にとって冷蔵室は冷たすぎることがあるんだ。
prompts: a cheerful cartoon carrot wearing a scarf shivering gently, simple illustration, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style
a bright refrigerator shelf with a small thermometer, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: 冷蔵庫はもともと、食品が傷む微生物を抑えるための低温なんだ。
prompts: a clean bright refrigerator interior with milk and eggs on shelves, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: だから野菜室は、少し高めの温度に設定されていると言われている。
prompts: a vegetable drawer with tomatoes, lettuce and cucumbers, a warm gentle glow, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style
a small thermometer beside a basket of fresh vegetables, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: さらに野菜室は、湿度を保ちやすい作りになっているよ。
prompts: fresh green lettuce with tiny water droplets in a vegetable drawer, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style
a closed vegetable drawer with a soft misty look, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: なすやきゅうりなど、夏の野菜は寒すぎると傷みやすいんだって。
prompts: an eggplant and cucumbers in a bright kitchen, cheerful, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style
a plastic bag wrapping fresh cucumbers on a kitchen table, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a bright kitchen with a colorful basket of fresh vegetables, bright daylight, cheerful, simple storybook style
